content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents to identify all relevant project documents, especially candidate_specs.md plus any simulation, performance, optical, or ageing-test documents needed to evaluate pion/kaon separation and humidity transparency loss."},{"id":"s2","description":"Read candidate_specs.md. Extract the three permitted radiator candidates, assign them numeric IDs 1–3 for later reference, and record any numeric material parameters relevant to RICH performance and allowed thickness selection, such as refractive index, photon yield or attenuation length if given."},{"id":"s3","description":"Read the humidity ageing or materials QA document(s). For each of the three candidate IDs, determine the 10-year-equivalent transparency loss in percent, record the numeric losses, and record pass/fail flags where pass means transparency loss is <=10%."},{"id":"s4","description":"Read the simulation/performance document(s). For each candidate that passes the humidity requirement, evaluate or extract the pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c over the allowed 1–6 cm thickness range; identify the thickness giving the maximum separation for that candidate, and record the best thickness and corresponding separation sigma."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare the recorded best separations against the hard requirement of at least 3.5 sigma and select the humidity-passing candidate/thickness combination with the highest pion/kaon separation. Record the selected candidate ID, thickness in cm, separation sigma, and transparency loss percent for the reporting module; if no candidate satisfies both hard requirements, record a numeric failure flag."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Radiator-R2","thickness_cm":6,"justification":"No performance/simulation data were available in the recorded results, so the 10 GeV/c pion/kaon separation hard requirement cannot be verified. If a single candidate must be submitted despite the missing performance evidence, R2 at the maximum allowed thickness of 6 cm is the least-risk humidity-compliant choice and is expected to maximize photon yield within the allowed thickness range.
